Self-propelled agricultural sprayers: HTSUS 8424.82 covers agricultural or horticultural sprayers, but 8424.82 applies to mechanical appliances for projecting liquids or powders. Self-propelled sprayers have historically been classified in 8701.91 or 8424.81, depending on the ruling. CBP rulings (e.g., N-series for Case Patriot sprayers) have classified self-propelled sprayers under 8424.82.0090 or similar. Chapter 87 note: Heading 8701 covers tractors, meaning vehicles constructed essentially for hauling or pushing another machine. A sprayer is not a tractor, so it is classified under 8424.

The 8424.81 subheading covers "Agricultural or horticultural," and 8424.82 covers "Agricultural or horticultural" sprayers, with 8424.81 for other appliances. The correct structure is:
- 8424.81: Agricultural or horticultural
- 8424.81.10: Sprayers... in the HTSUS, 8424.81.10 is "Foggers"? Actually 8424.81.10 is "Agricultural or horticultural: Sprayers, ... Other: 8424.81.2000 Hand-operated? 8424.81.30 Foggers? 8424.81.90?

The HTSUS has 8424.82.00 "Agricultural or horticultural" as a subheading with 8424.82.0010 "Irrigation sprinklers", 8424.82.0090 "Other"? In 8424.81 (agricultural or horticultural), the breakdown is: 8424.81.10 Sprayers, mounted on or drawn by tractors (8424.81.2000?), 8424.81.30 Other sprayers, 8424.81.90 Other. In the actual HTSUS, 8424.81 is "Agricultural or horticultural," and 8424.82 is "Other." Hmm: 8424.82 is "Agricultural or horticultural" and 8424.89 is "Other." And 8424.81 is "Other appliances"? In HS 2022: 8424.30 steam/sand blasting; 8424.41 portable sprayers; 8424.49 other; 8424.81 agricultural or horticultural; 8424.89 other. So 8424.81 is agricultural. In the HTSUS, 8424.81: 8424.81.10 Sprayers... 8424.81.2000 Irrigation; 8424.81.30 Sprayers? 8424.81.9000 other. Self-propelled sprayers are likely 8424.81.1000 or 8424.81.9000? I'll go with 8424.81.9000, as it's likely.
